name: io.github.StanimirTenev/fleetpost-mcp
title: Fleetpost
description: A mailbox for your machines: read fleet capabilities, send a request. Offline, no server.

environmentVariables.name: FLEETPOST_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to your Fleetpost config.env. Optional if you start the server from the checkout that contains it.

environmentVariables.name: FLEETPOST_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Fleetpost checkout, if config.env was copied away from it. Needed by fleet_sync and fleet_handle.
